To check the current weather in **Berlin, Germany**, you can use reliable weather services like:

- **[Weather.com (The Weather Channel)](https://weather.com)**
- **[AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com)**
- **[Windy.com](https://www.windy.com)** (for real-time updates)
- **[Meteoblue](https://www.meteoblue.com)** (detailed forecasts)

### **Quick Check (Approximate as of now)**
Since I don’t have real-time data, here’s a general idea (you should verify for accuracy):
- **Temperature**: Around **10–15°C (50–59°F)** (varies by time of day).
- **Conditions**: Likely **partly cloudy** or **overcast**, with possible **light rain** (common in Berlin).
- **Wind**: Moderate (5–15 km/h).

For the **most up-to-date** info, I recommend checking one of the links above or using a weather app like **Apple Weather, Google Weather, or Windy**.

Would you like help interpreting a weather forecast? 😊
